For a detailed quote, provide the expected quantity, target market, logo or label direction, blade-pack requirement and packaging reference. This supports sample planning and inspection of blade fit, welded structure and finished packaging.

faq.question: What applications suit a stainless steel utility knife?
faq.answer: It can be considered for carton opening, warehouse, hardware and industrial cutting programs; buyers should confirm the target material and user requirements.

faq.question: Can the steel body carry a logo?
faq.answer: Logo marking, retail labels, barcode and carton marks can be reviewed for private-label projects.

faq.question: What should be checked before bulk ordering?
faq.answer: Confirm blade fit, body and rivet finish, welded structure, blade-pack requirement, packaging and target market labeling.
